roadmap.title: Story and incidental unlocks
roadmap.description: Play Acts 1 to 5 on any difficulty and use the skill tree while you go. Tag enemies, take down vehicles, stop phone calls, and play five City Games along the way.

roadmap.title: Chicago cleanup
roadmap.description: Unlock every ctOS Tower, then clear Fixer contracts, gang hideouts, convoys, investigations, hotspots, breaches, songs, drinking games, police escapes and the full skill tree.

roadmap.title: Online activities
roadmap.description: Turn on Online Invasions and play the online hacking, tailing and race contracts. Stay patient for Traced.

roadmap.title: Bad Blood DLC
roadmap.description: Buy Bad Blood, finish its three acts, then clear the contract, driving, co-op and side-investigation lists.

achievements.summary: Take down Maurice in the main story.

steps.text: Play the main story until the mission where you take down Maurice.

achievements.summary: Complete 40 Fixer Contracts.

guide.context: Only 40 contracts count, even if more are available.

steps.text: Hack people on the street so Fixer Contract popups appear while you drive. You can also replay a finished contract from the contract app on your phone.
Accept each contract and finish it. Contracts show as blue steering-wheel icons on the map.
Check the Progression Wheel in the Statistics app on your phone until it shows 40.

achievements.sortReason: 15 hideouts, some gated by Fixer contracts.
achievements.summary: Complete all 15 Gang Hideouts.

guide.context: The leader cannot be killed. Staying undetected stops the leader from fleeing, and a crafted @item{ctOS scan} shows where everyone stands. One hideout only appears after 25 Fixer contracts are done.

steps.text: Hack civilians on the street until the blue fist icons for Gang Hideouts appear.
Enter a hideout, find the marked leader, and take that person down with a non-lethal takedown.
Repeat until the Progression Wheel shows every hideout complete.

achievements.summary: Complete every Investigation by finishing the final mission of each one.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks on its own once Revoking Client Privileges, Saturday Night Special, Sanity Check, Read-only and Darkness Looms are all done.

steps.text: Finish the Human Traffic, Weapons Trade, QR Code and Missing Persons investigations and collect all 8 Burner Phones.
Check the Progression Wheel to confirm all investigations are complete.

achievements.summary: Complete all 30 Privacy Invasions.

steps.text: Unlock ctOS Towers to reveal the white eye icons on the map.
At each location, hack the security router outside.
Look into the room to finish that Privacy Invasion. Repeat for all 30.

achievements.summary: Complete every Criminal Convoy.

steps.text: Hack civilians on the street to reveal the blue wheel convoy icons.
Start a convoy, then knock down or kill its target. Getting ahead and placing IEDs or setting off steam pipes on its route is the easiest way.
Repeat until you have finished 18 convoys.

achievements.description: Use the Crime Detection System to take down 20 confirmed criminals
achievements.summary: Take down 20 criminals that the Crime Detection System has confirmed.

steps.text: Drive around until a blue circle with a triangle appears, then use the Profiler to find the criminal and the victim.
Stay out of sight until the crime happens or the Intervene prompt appears.
Take the criminal down. Repeat 20 times.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 1.

steps.text: Finish every main mission in Act 1.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 2.

steps.text: Finish every main mission in Act 2.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 3.

steps.text: Finish every main mission in Act 3.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 4.

steps.text: Finish every main mission in Act 4.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 5.

steps.text: Finish every main mission in Act 5.

achievements.summary: Perform 10 vehicle takedowns.

steps.text: Get into police chases and wreck the pursuing cars with steam pipes, blockers, traffic lights or by ramming them until they are destroyed.

achievements.description: Using non-lethal takedown, stop 10 civilians from calling to report you
achievements.summary: Stop 10 civilians from calling the police on you using a non-lethal takedown.

steps.text: Commit a crime in public, such as firing a weapon, so a civilian starts a phone call.
Run up to the caller while unarmed and use the takedown to take the phone. Repeat 10 times.

achievements.summary: Tag 100 enemies.

steps.text: Aim the Profiler at enemies to tag them during fights until you reach 100.

achievements.sortReason: Any 5 City Games; winning not required.
achievements.summary: Participate in 5 different City Games.

guide.context: Games include Chess, Drinking Game, Poker, Shell Game and Slot Machine.

steps.text: Start any five different City Games from the dark blue icons on the map. Winning is not required.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies within a single instance of Focus
achievements.sortReason: Needs the Focus skill and a group of enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 4 enemies within a single use of Focus.

steps.text: Unlock Focus in the Combat section of the Skills Tree.
Wait for four enemies to stand close together, activate Focus, and kill all four before it ends.

achievements.summary: Escape 15 police chases.

steps.text: Commit a crime until a civilian reports you and the police arrive.
Break away from the chase until it ends. Repeat 15 times.

achievements.summary: Escape a level 5 police chase.

steps.text: Kill police until your wanted level reaches 5. Helicopters, armored police and armored cars will join the chase.
Break away from every pursuer until the chase ends.

achievements.summary: Escape 15 police scans.

guide.context: A scan is the search phase between the call and the chase. The chase begins if a circle reaches 100% while you stand inside it.

steps.text: Get the police called on you, then keep out of the expanding yellow circles on the map until the scan ends.
Repeat 15 times. A crafted @item{Jam Coms}, which you must unlock in the Skills Tree, stalls the search.

achievements.sortReason: Scan must begin at wanted level 5.
achievements.summary: Escape a police scan while at wanted level 5.

guide.context: The level must already be 5 when the scan starts.

steps.text: Raise your wanted level to 5 by killing civilians. Stop callers before their call finishes so the scan does not start early.
Once you are at level 5, let one call go through so a scan begins.
Stay out of the yellow circles until the scan ends.

achievements.description: Shoot out a tire on 15 different vehicles
achievements.sortReason: Shoot out tires on parked or moving cars.
achievements.summary: Blow out the tires of 15 separate vehicles.

steps.text: Shoot the tires of parked or moving cars until you have done it to 15 different vehicles.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single IED
achievements.sortReason: Needs the IED skill and a group of enemies.
achievements.summary: Get 3 kills from one IED explosion.

steps.text: Unlock the IED in the Skills Tree.
Place an IED near police parked together during a chase and detonate it when three are close.

achievements.description: Complete the final mission in the Human Traffic Investigation
achievements.summary: Complete the final mission of the Human Traffic Investigation.

guide.context: There are 11 missions in this investigation.

steps.text: In each earlier Human Traffic mission, scan the buyer where the marker shows, then look through their apartment to find a briefcase.
In the final mission, eliminate the target.

achievements.description: Complete the final mission in the Weapons Trade Investigation
achievements.sortReason: Final mission unlocks after Jury Rigged.
achievements.summary: Complete the final mission of the Weapons Trade Investigation.

guide.context: There are 9 missions in this investigation.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Jury Rigged in Act 2 so the final mission unlocks.
In each earlier mission, hack the panels to reveal hidden weapon crates and scan them.
In the final mission, survive three waves. Bring every type of explosive for the armored enemies.

achievements.sortReason: Burner Phones appear as towers unlock.
achievements.summary: Collect all 8 Burner Phones.

steps.text: Unlock all 13 ctOS Towers and progress the story so the black W icons appear on the map.
Hack each phone to collect it. The phones in Pawnee only appear after the first mission of Act 3.

achievements.description: Complete the final mission in the QR Code Investigation
achievements.summary: Complete the final mission of the QR Code Investigation.

steps.text: Unlock ctOS Towers so the QR Code icons appear on the map.
At each location, find every broken piece of the code, then view them through a security camera to line them up.
Scan every code. After the last one, finish the final mission.

achievements.description: Complete the final mission of the Missing Persons Investigation
achievements.summary: Finish the last mission of the Missing Persons Investigation.

guide.context: There are 7 missions in this investigation.

steps.text: Go to each marked location, find the dead body and scan it.
In the last mission, stop a crime as it happens, just like a random crime.

achievements.summary: Check in at all 100 Hotspots.

steps.text: Go to each bright white check mark on the map and use the check-in button.
The mark turns dark after you check in. Continue until all 100 are done.

achievements.description: Unlock every song with the SongSneak app
achievements.summary: Unlock all 23 songs with the SongSneak app.

steps.text: Progress the main story, which gives 3 songs.

Hack civilians who are playing music; 3 songs can only be taken this way. For the rest, open SongSneak whenever a song plays from a speaker, such as at newsstands, bars, clothing shops, coffee shops and gun shops. Do not change the speaker's song yourself.
Keep going until all 23 songs are unlocked.

achievements.description: Complete level 10 against all 3 Drinking Game opponents
achievements.sortReason: Level 10 in all three Drinking Games.
achievements.summary: Reach level 10 in the Drinking Game with each of its 3 opponents.

steps.text: Play the Drinking Game in The Loop and in The Ward first, up to level 10 each.
Then play the Drinking Game in Pawnee to level 10, since it combines the other two.
Finish each turn quickly after a drink, because the screen darkens as time runs out.

achievements.description: Invade and successfully hack 10 enemy Fixers in Online Hacking
achievements.summary: Successfully hack the phones of 10 enemy Fixers by invading in Online Hacking.

guide.context: The more progress you make, the smaller the area the other player has to search.

steps.text: On your phone open the Contracts menu and choose Online Hacking.
Track down your opponent and hack into their phone without letting them profile you. Stay hidden as the progress bar fills.
Repeat until you have 10 successful hacks.

achievements.description: Invade and successfully observe 10 enemy Fixers in Online Tailing
achievements.summary: Successfully tail 10 enemy Fixers to full observation by invading in Online Tailing.

steps.text: Open the Online Contracts app, choose Online Tailing, then Request Tailing Target.
Follow the target without being profiled. Act like a civilian: no wild driving, no weapons.
Keep tailing until the Observe meter reaches 100%. Repeat 10 times.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 Public Online Races.

steps.text: Open the Online Contracts app, choose Online Race, then Join Public Session.
Finish the race. You do not have to win, but a Did Not Finish does not count.

achievements.summary: Complete all 16 ctOS Breaches.

steps.text: Unlock ctOS Towers so the black arrow icons appear.
At each breach, hack the first device. Four more devices then appear.
Hack all four before the time limit ends.

achievements.description: Complete an Online Tailing without being detected
achievements.summary: Finish one Online Tailing while the target never detects you.

steps.text: Open the Online Contracts app, choose Online Tailing, then Request Tailing Target.
Follow the target without being profiled and stay inconspicuous until the Observe meter reaches 100%.

achievements.description: Unlock every Skill in the Skills Tree
achievements.sortReason: Needs 52 skills; best at the end.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 52 skills in the Skills Tree.

steps.text: Level up to earn skill points. Experience comes from side missions, story missions, stopping crimes, online wins and kills.
Spend points until all 52 skills are unlocked. Some skills also need a set number of side or story missions completed.

achievements.summary: Get tailed by other players 5 times.

guide.context: You cannot trigger this or see the count. It happens only when other players enter your game.

steps.text: Turn on Online Invasions in the game options.
Keep playing in free roam until other players have tailed you 5 times in total.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 13 ctOS Towers.

steps.text: Reach each red tower icon. Its entrance is behind a gate tied to devices you must hack.
Use security cameras to reach far devices and follow the white wires with your phone out.
Hack every device linked to the gate to open it.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 1 of Bad Blood.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Act 1 of the Bad Blood DLC.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 2 of Bad Blood.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Act 2 of the Bad Blood DLC.

achievements.summary: Complete Act 3 of Bad Blood.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Act 3 of the Bad Blood DLC.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Chicago South Club contracts in Bad Blood.

guide.context: You may play these contracts alone or with a partner.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Fading Signal.
Take Chicago South Club contracts from the orange fist icons and complete 20.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Militia contracts in Bad Blood.

guide.context: You may play these contracts alone or with a partner.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Fading Signal.
Take Militia contracts from the orange icons with two arrows and complete 20.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Fixer contracts in Bad Blood.

guide.context: You may play these contracts alone or with a partner.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Fading Signal.
Take Fixer contracts from the orange icons with horizontal lines and complete 20.

achievements.summary: Complete 29 driving missions in Bad Blood.

guide.context: Driving missions cannot be played in co-op.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Fading Signal.
Do the driving missions from the orange steering-wheel icons, in single player, until 29 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 co-op missions in Bad Blood.

guide.context: Chicago South Club, Militia and Fixer missions can be played co-op, and the same completions count toward their own achievements.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Fading Signal.
Start a co-op mission from your phone or the white skull icon on the map, and play it with a partner. Do this 10 times.

achievements.summary: Complete all side investigations in Bad Blood.

steps.text: Finish the story mission Bait to unlock the first investigation.
Finish the story mission Illusions to unlock the second.
Complete both from the white icons on the map.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies at once by blowing up the RC Car
achievements.sortReason: Needs RC Car detonator after 15 Militia contracts.
achievements.summary: Get 4 kills with one RC Car explosion in Bad Blood.

guide.context: The final story mission has four enemies searching close together just before its last area.

steps.text: Finish the Needs of the Few story mission, which gives you the RC Car.
Do 15 Militia contracts to get the car's detonator.
Blow up the car while four or more enemies are grouped.
